title: Live-cell luciferase assay of drug resistant cells
protocol: Culture cells in 96-well plates by time point.
Equilibrate the plate to room temperature for 30 min.
Prepare control wells containing medium without cells for background.
Add a volume of luciferin solution equal to the volume of cell culture medium in each well.
Mix the contents of the plate by gently shaking for 5 sec.
Immediately detect the luminescence with a luminescent plate reader.
